limits: Internal observation acceptance remains distinct from pending user visual approval and production readiness.
This public phase ran seven checks. Full scope including cancellation, identity/exports and the twelve-case suite belongs to the byte-identical accepted suite, not this public replay.
Headless Chromium 145.0.7632.6 / Playwright 1.58.2 / SwiftShader on GitHub Actions; no physical phone or user-device GPU was exercised.
Cold initialization took 267455 ms in this software rendering environment. Actual completed-frame times are slow and must not be replaced by RAF cadence when reporting performance.
The native data remains a pinned-network build; the complete 84045179-byte original archive is not embedded as an offline artifact.
Existing initial bottle Cartesian-target clamp is preserved and disclosed; no claim of perfect bottle approach tracking is made.

Contact is assisted point grip plus sampled native skin/physical-solid geometry. Continuous triangle collision, whole-body dynamics, muscle deformation, finger friction and general room autonomy remain outside this observation proof.
